$comment: tier: lite — Records paths bassclef install writers created. Discipline hooks consult this manifest (via lib/install-written-paths.sh) to skip install-written files, firing discipline on author-edited paths only. Per bassclef-upstream#2036 Finding #8.
title: Install-Written-Paths Manifest
description: Records paths written by bassclef install writers so discipline hooks can skip them. Per bassclef-upstream#2036 Finding #8 structural cure.

schema_version.description: Semver for this manifest shape. V1 = 1.0.0.

entries.description: One entry per install-written path. Idempotent on (path, writer); one entry per path.

path.description: Project-relative path. Must not contain '../'. Must resolve under $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.

writer.description: Identifier of the install writer that created the path.

written_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the write.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of file content at write time, prefixed with algorithm.
